resources.string: 🛡️ Protection is ON — new images are checked as soon as they are saved.
Protection is OFF. Turn on auto-protect below.
Finish setup to start protecting this phone.
ImageGuard needs file access to remove images from your gallery, Downloads and other folders. On Samsung phones, also turn off battery optimisation so protection keeps running in the background.
Checks every new photo, screenshot and download the moment it is saved, and removes explicit ones automatically. Keeps running after a restart.
Lower = stricter: more is blocked, but some normal photos (e.g. swimwear) may be caught. Higher = only clearly explicit images. Default: 60%.
Filter web searches, adult sites & ads

Works in every browser and app. Forces SafeSearch on Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and YouTube (explicit images are hidden from search results), blocks about 150,000 adult, ad, tracker and malware sites, and checks every other site against AdGuard's family-safe DNS.
✅ Web filter is ON (shown as a VPN key icon in the status bar).
Tap the ⚙️ next to ImageGuard, then turn on "Always-on VPN" and "Block connections without VPN".

For it to work everywhere: in Chrome go to Settings → Privacy and security → Use secure DNS and turn it OFF; in phone Settings → Connections → More connection settings, set Private DNS to Off or Automatic. Only one VPN can run at a time.
The web filter needs VPN permission to work.
Your existing photos have not been scanned yet.

Photos are checked on this phone and are never uploaded anywhere. The web filter only sends website names (DNS lookups) to AdGuard Family DNS; it does not see the pages you visit. Removed images are kept in a private, hidden quarantine so you can restore false alarms.
Find ImageGuard in the list and switch on \"Allow access to manage all files\".
These images were removed from your phone. They are hidden from the gallery and other apps. Restore any that were removed by mistake; they won\'t be removed again.
It was flagged as possibly explicit.
These images will be gone for good and cannot be restored.
